mail.body1:
I don't know if anyone will see this email.

People around school have been talking lately.

I don't know who you really are, but if you actually want to change something...

Maybe I can help.
mail.body2:
Every day is the same.

Patrols, inspections, pressure, rules.

Everyone pretends things are normal, but nobody is really happy.

If this is serious, I want to join.
mail.body3:
I heard some students were questioned recently.

I don't know if it was because of that forum.

If this email is dangerous, delete it.

But if it is safe... I want to know what you are doing.
mail.body4:
They searched everyone's lockers.

I've had enough of living like this.

If you are preparing to act, count me in.
mail.body5:
I know you have been growing quickly.

I can help, but I don't want to be treated as disposable.

Contact me again if you can really protect your members.
mail.body6:
I have watched your organization for a long time.

More students are starting to realize that the school is not what it pretends to be.

I want to join officially.

You do not need to reply. I can wait near the tennis court after lunch tomorrow, or you can contact me online.
